innocence.line: They'll rob you of your innocence
stanza: They'll rob you of your innocence
They will put you up for sale
The more that you will find success
The more that you will fail
I've been around, I've had my share
But I wonder who I left behind

innocence.line: Left there to drown in their innocence
stanza: Cause that's all that you'll get so you'll have to accept
You are here then you're gone
But I believe that lovers should be tied together
Thrown into the ocean in the worst of weather
Left there to drown in their innocence

innocence.line: This is the end of the innocence
stanza: You can lay your head back on the ground
And let your hair fall all around me
This is the end of the innocence
